  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer serves no unapproved value (new, D-RCV-60)

    Then the client serves no value that is not approved

  Scenario: AC10 A load status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given version 2 of "case.entry.dpd" has load status VALIDATED and is not APPROVED
    When a load status change for version 2 arrives that the load status model does not allow
    Then the client refuses the change and keeps the status VALIDATED
    Then version 2 is not served, read from the cache or from the owner
